bio: I am a Second-Year BSc (Hons) Computer Science undergraduate at the University of Westminster (studying at Informatics Institute of Technology — IIT, Sri Lanka), specializing in full-stack software engineering, identity & access security, and machine learning pipelines.

From architecting an enterprise OAuth 2.0 / OIDC Single Sign-On platform with FIDO2 WebAuthn passkeys during my SLT Internship, to engineering ZenData's 4-pillar automated data hygiene engine and a 99.97%-accurate Loan Approval ML classifier, I love turning complex real-world problems into resilient, user-centric systems.
Beyond code, I represented De Mazenod College in Badminton, Tennis, and Cricket, and bring strong creative skills in UI/UX planning, photography, and videography to every product I build.

queries.question: What engineering areas and services do I specialize in?
queries.answer: I specialize in building secure full-stack web applications (React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, FastAPI), enterprise authentication & identity systems (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, WebAuthn FIDO2), cross-platform mobile apps (Flutter & Firebase), and end-to-end Python data quality and machine learning pipelines.

queries.question: What kind of opportunities am I looking for?
queries.answer: I am actively open to Software Engineering, Full-Stack, Cybersecurity, and Data/ML Internship opportunities, as well as collaborative open-source and freelance product development projects.

queries.question: What technologies do I work with daily?
queries.answer: My core stack includes Python (FastAPI, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn), JavaScript/TypeScript (React, Next.js, Redux Toolkit, Node.js, Express, Tailwind CSS), Java, Dart/Flutter, PostgreSQL, Firebase, Docker, and Nginx.

queries.question: How does this portfolio stay up to date automatically?
queries.answer: A scheduled GitHub Actions workflow runs daily and on every push. It queries the GitHub REST API for my public repositories, extracts README descriptions, calculates real-time language byte distributions, and updates the Projects, Skills, and Timeline sections automatically.

queries.question: How do I approach security and code quality?
queries.answer: With formal certifications in Cyber Security & Networking and hands-on experience building OAuth 2.0 + PKCE and FIDO2 passkey systems, I integrate rate limiting, JWT rotation, input sanitization, and Docker/Nginx hardening right from the architecture stage.
